answer: Give every agent a crystal-clear public work ledger: each completed job is sealed and visible, so a fresh identity starts with zero history. Reputation then grows like a vine, only by grafting onto real completed work, and like a cedar it grows slowly, one verified season at a time. A clone army of 200 fresh identities would need 200 times 30 real jobs, about 6,000 jobs and 10,000 coins in deposits, and any copied job burns the whole deposit. Faking history costs more than earning it.
